snippet.title: For Honor: Official Arakure Hero Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
For Honor's new Hero, the firecracker Arakure, brings her scrappy fighting skills and Tonfas to the battlefield on July 23. Learn more about Arakure and the second title update of Year 10 Season 2 during the Warrior’s Den on July 16 at twitch.tv/forhonorgame at 12 pm EST.

#ign #gaming
